docs-scene3d-ci.description: Docs route under CI software rasterization with lazy WebGL fallback preserved. Exact native page network measurement of the shared scene3d feature: docs network 1548.310546875KiB vs previous 1543.4287109375KiB — exactly 4999 raw bytes growth (1584 shared + 1079 WebGL + 2336 WebGPU). Docs loads all three chunks and settles to the WebGL fallback. Measured JS 1314.18KiB (<= 1550), LCP 1868ms (<= 18000), TBT 1333ms (<= 15000) all pass unchanged; only network exceeded the prior 1544KiB cap, so the cap moves to 1549KiB — the next integer KiB above the measured 1548.310546875KiB payload. Fresh remote CI on this head is pending; no hardware certification is implied.

water-ci.description: Water route under CI software rasterization. Gates load, network payload, and total blocking time; long-task count is intentionally ungated because continuous software-raster frames straddle the 50ms boundary. Real-GPU cadence is certified separately. The latest remote CI browser run (head 28ec59ca, run 33185621903) FAILED the water network gate at 1678.29KiB > 1674KiB while timing gates passed; no remote resource artifact is available, so the backend that run loaded is not asserted. This slice adds 2159 shared + 5266 WebGL raw bytes (7425 total) with WebGPU unchanged, and water loads shared + WebGPU locally. Conservative maximum-payload projection: 1678.29 + 7425/1024 = 1685.541953125KiB, so the assertion moves to 1686KiB. This is a conservative projection from the previous remote measurement allowing both updated chunks — NOT a measured new remote result or hardware certification. Fresh CI is pending.
